illustration_style: Adult colouring-book ink illustration with an artisanal harvest-market feel; clean monochrome drawings built from graceful organic contours and decorative botanical styling.
line_weight: Fine-to-medium black outlines with a restrained variation in weight; slightly bolder exterior silhouettes and focal contours.
line_quality: Crisp, confident hand-inked strokes with gently irregular handmade character; smooth curves, tidy joins and clearly enclosed colourable areas.
detail_level: Moderately detailed, concentrating pattern and texture in selected natural surfaces, foliage and decorative accents while preserving broad open areas for relaxed colouring.
background_density: Light to moderate. Supporting details form airy frames, borders or small clusters around the central motif, never filling every gap or competing with the focal area.
composition: Clear central hierarchy with one immediately readable focal grouping; balanced, stable arrangements; decorative elements guide the eye inward; purposeful white space and optional calm header space for titles.
palette: Monochrome black ink on bright white paper only.
shading: No grey fills, gradients or solid black shadow masses. Suggest depth through sparse contour lines, selective hatching and simple repeating textures only.
texture: Subtle hand-drawn organic texture through vein lines, woodgrain-like marks, gentle stippling and small repeat motifs; keep all textures open and colourable.
mood: Calm, abundant, wholesome and quietly celebratory; refined seasonal warmth without spooky, childish or rustic-cliché treatment.
print_considerations: High-contrast black-only line art designed for home printing on A4 and US Letter. Use clean enclosed shapes, avoid hairline details and large ink-heavy fills, and retain a comfortable unillustrated safety margin around page edges.
shared_prompt: Original adult colouring-book illustration in crisp hand-inked black line art on clean white paper; elegant organic contours, fine-to-medium varied outlines, slightly bolder focal silhouettes, and softly handmade yet precise line quality. Use moderately detailed, open colourable forms with selective botanical texture, sparse hatching and delicate repeat patterns; no grey shading, gradients or solid fills. Maintain a calm central hierarchy, balanced decorative framing, generous breathing room and an artisanal, abundant seasonal mood. High-contrast, home-print-friendly monochrome artwork.
avoid: Any Halloween, spooky, occult or horror imagery
Photorealism, colour, grey wash, gradients or painted shading
Dense clutter, tiny inaccessible details or heavily inked black areas
Trademarked packaging, recognisable logos, branded labels or copied market signage
Copied compositions or distinctive artwork from existing colouring books
Uneven broken outlines, muddy intersections or unclosed colourable shapes
